summary_en: Hokuto Corporation authorized the acquisition of up to 80,000 shares (0.25% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥2.0 billion through market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 from November 20 to November 30, 2026, to flexibly execute capital policy in response to changing business conditions.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On November 13, 2026, Hokuto Corporation's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 80,000 shares of its own common stock for a maximum total consideration of ¥2.0 billion. The acquisition represents 0.25% of the company's outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026, when 31,817,563 shares were outstanding excluding treasury holdings. The acquisition will be executed through market purchases, including trades on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's off-line negotiated transaction system (ToSTNeT-3), between November 20 and November 30, 2026. The implicit ceiling price is ¥25,000 per share, calculated from the maximum consideration divided by the maximum number of shares. The company intends to pursue flexible capital management in response to changing business conditions. All necessary matters for executing this acquisition have been delegated to the representative director.
